description: This file defines the interface BalsaVisitorInterface for handling various events during HTTP message parsing in the BalsaFrame component, including header, body, trailer processing, and error handling.

classes.name: quiche::BalsaVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for handling events during HTTP message parsing, including header, body, trailer, and error processing.

methods.name: OnBodyChunkInput
methods.description: Handles body chunk data after chunking removal.

methods.name: OnRequestFirstLineInput
methods.description: Handles the first line of an HTTP request.

methods.name: OnResponseFirstLineInput
methods.description: Handles the first line of an HTTP response.

methods.name: ContinueHeaderDone
methods.description: Indicates completion of 100 Continue headers processing.

methods.name: HeaderDone
methods.description: Indicates headers have been fully processed.

methods.name: MessageDone
methods.description: Indicates the entire message has been processed.
